page_title: MON 2-3 LEV | B. Monchengladbach v Bayer Leverkusen 23/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+14' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+13' The attendance for today's match is 54000.
90+13' Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
90+11' 2 - 3 Goal! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the middle of the net. It's 2:3.

90+11' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Jonas Omlin to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
90+11' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+10' The Bayer Leverkusen players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
90+9' Referee Robert Schroder makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
90+8' The opposition back off Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies over the bar. Unlucky!
90+7' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+7' A cross from Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

90+6' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Lukas Hradecky thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
90+6' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Tim Kleindienst.
90+5' A substitution has been made. Franck Honorat is replaced by Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach).
90+5' Luca Netz goes off the pitch and Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach) comes on.
90+4' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

90+1' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
90' 10 additional min. will be played.
90' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
89' The foul by Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) was seen by Robert Schroder who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
88' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
87' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
87' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and B. Monchengladbach players have a reason to celebrate!
86' Wait! Referee Robert Schroder has indicated he is going to review the B. Monchengladbach goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
85' 2 - 2 Goal! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Kevin Stoger, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
84' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jonas Omlin, who smothers the ball.
82' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
82' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Victor Boniface is replaced by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
82' The manager makes a subsitution with Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) coming on for Robert Andrich.
81' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) as his effort only hit the wall.
79' Dangerous play by Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach). Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen have a free kick from a promising distance.
79' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
78' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
77' Good defending. Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Victor Boniface inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
77' Bayer Leverkusen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
75' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
74' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner.

74' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayer Leverkusen will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Here is a change. Rocco Reitz is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach).
71' Alassane Plea will be replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).

70' That's a well-taken pass by Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.
70' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

68' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
66' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
66' Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Jonas Omlin is equal to it and makes an easy save.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jonas Hofmann leaves the pitch and Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
64' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bayer Leverkusen.
62' Robert Schroder sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
60' The B. Monchengladbach players halt their celebrations as referee Robert Schroder makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
59' 1 - 2 Goal! Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
58' Robert Schroder blows his whistle. Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul after dangerous play. B. Monchengladbach earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
58' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!

55' This was a piece of cake for Jonas Omlin. Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
54' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
53' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
48' The game is interrupted.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+2' Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' The B. Monchengladbach players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Robert Schroder signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to a foul.
44' The goal for B. Monchengladbach is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
43' Goal! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
42' Robert Schroder blows for a foul after Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick.

38' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Alejandro Grimaldo has a shot blocked, but the ball falls to Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) who finds some space inside the box and lashes the ball inside the right post. The score is 0:2.
37' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

37' B. Monchengladbach will take a corner kick. The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
36' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Robert Schroder saw the whole situation.
34' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukas Hradecky intercepts the ball.
33' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
32' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from B. Monchengladbach for a penalty. Play continues.

30' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Robert Schroder blows his whistle for a foul. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
29' Some neat passing and movement from B. Monchengladbach as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
26' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for B. Monchengladbach.

26' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Schroder has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bayer Leverkusen.

23' Good touch by Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) as he latched on to an accurate pass before attempting to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range shot. Unluckily for him, his attempt only rattles the left post. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.

21' A sweet pass finds Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Lukas Hradecky is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
20' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
20' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
19' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

18' Crossbar! Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box, but his attempt only rattles the crossbar! The goalkeeper can remain calm.
17' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
14' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Lukas Hradecky pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.

12' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) quickly gets to a rebound. He is not worried how far out he is and slams the ball towards the goal. To the amazement of all, it goes all the way into the top left corner. He makes it 0:1 with this magnificent strike.
11' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) serves up a nice cross, but Jonas Omlin punches the ball away.
9' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) tries to find Victor Boniface with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
7' Bayer Leverkusen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
7' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
5' The free kick is taken by Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen), but ball is cleared.

5' Nico Elvedi (B. Monchengladbach) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Schroder interrupted the game to signal a free kick. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

4' So close! Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
4' A lofted cross from Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
3' A pass by Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and B. Monchengladbach will take a throw-in.
2' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! B. Monchengladbach will take the kick-off.
Robert Schroder was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
